items.label: Size and Material
items.value: XS=US 0-2, S=US 4-6, M=US 8-10, L=US 12-14, XL=US 16-18, XXL=20-22. Thickness - Lightweight, suitable for autumn; Softness - Medium; Elasticity - Slightly stretchy; Fit Type - Slim fit; Length - Regular. Lining: Double layer at the chest area, ensuring it's not see-through

items.label: Care Instructions
items.value: Machine wash cold gently with like colors, we recommend using a laundry bag. Do not bleach. Hang to dry or tumble dry on low heat. Vacuum packaging may cause wrinkles. It is recommended to iron at low temperature before wearing for a better experience

items.label: Features
items.value: Off the shoulder tops for women, going out tops for women, trendy long sleeve tops, bell sleeve, solid color, spring tops, ruched tops, Y2K tops, plain t shirts for women, sexy fitted tops dressy casual, fall tops, winter undershirt, black tops, white long sleeve shirts, brown tops, red tops

items.label: Design
items.value: This slim fitted top features a one-shoulder design to flatter your collarbone and enhance feminine charm with a classic yet elegant style. The trendy flared sleeves are eye-catching while allowing freedom of movement for the wrists. Upgrade your spring and fall fashion taste with this dressy top

items.label: Occasions and Matching
items.value: Trendy and sexy style, suitable for casual, going out, date night, club, party, holiday, school, evening, streetwear, daily wear, trips, etc. It’s a good idea to pair it with jeans, jewelry, and heels for a chic look or layer it under a cardigan or sweater in cold winter
